WITH ae AS (
  SELECT r.nct_id, r.date AS report_date,
         sum(r.subjects_affected) FILTER (WHERE r.event_type='serious') AS serious_aff,
         max(r.subjects_at_risk) FILTER (WHERE r.event_type='serious') AS risk,
         max(extract(epoch from (r.date - e2.start_date))/86400.0) AS lag_days,
         max(e2.phase) AS phase
  FROM public.reported_event_totals r
  JOIN public.studies e2 ON e2.nct_id = r.nct_id
  GROUP BY r.nct_id, r.date
)
SELECT s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
 extract(epoch from (s.seed_time - e.start_date)) / 86400.0 AS days_since_start_date,
 e.enrollment::double precision AS enrollment,
 ln(1 + greatest(coalesce(e.enrollment,0),0))::double precision AS log_enrollment,
 e.number_of_arms::double precision AS number_of_arms,
 e.number_of_groups::double precision AS number_of_groups,
 CASE e.phase WHEN 'Early Phase 1' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'Phase 1' THEN 1 WHEN 'Phase 1/Phase 2' THEN 1.5 WHEN 'Phase 2' THEN 2 WHEN 'Phase 2/Phase 3' THEN 2.5 WHEN 'Phase 3' THEN 3 WHEN 'Phase 4' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END AS phase_ord,
 CASE WHEN e.study_type = 'Interventional' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_interventional,
 CASE WHEN e.study_type LIKE 'Observational%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_observational,
 CASE WHEN e.enrollment_type = 'Anticipated' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS enrollment_anticipated,
 CASE WHEN e.has_dmc = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_dmc,
 CASE WHEN e.is_fda_regulated_drug = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fda_drug,
 CASE WHEN e.is_fda_regulated_device = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fda_device,
 CASE e.source_class WHEN 'Industry' THEN 1 WHEN 'NIH' THEN 2 WHEN 'Other Sponsor/Investigator' THEN 3 WHEN 'Network' THEN 4 WHEN 'U.S. Fed' THEN 5 WHEN 'Other' THEN 6 ELSE 0 END AS source_class_ord,
 CASE WHEN sp.agency_class = 'INDUSTRY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lead_industry,
 c.n_conditions,
 i.n_interventions,
 fa.n_facilities,
 fa.n_countries,
 fa.n_us_facilities,
 coalesce(spx.n_collab,0) AS n_collaborators,
 el.min_age_years,
 el.max_age_years,
 CASE WHEN el.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS female_only,
 CASE WHEN el.gender = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS male_only,
 CASE WHEN el.healthy_volunteers = 'Accepts Healthy Volunteers' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS healthy_volunteers,
 CASE WHEN el.adult = 't' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS adult,
 CASE WHEN el.child = 't' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS child,
 CASE WHEN d.allocation = 'Randomized' THEN 1 WHEN d.allocation = 'Non-Randomized' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS randomized,
 CASE d.masking WHEN 'None (Open Label)' THEN 0 WHEN 'Single' THEN 1 WHEN 'Double' THEN 2 WHEN 'Triple' THEN 3 WHEN 'Quadruple' THEN 4 END AS masking_ord,
 CASE WHEN d.primary_purpose = 'Treatment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS purpose_treatment,
 CASE WHEN d.primary_purpose = 'Prevention' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS purpose_prevention,
 CASE WHEN d.intervention_model = 'Parallel Assignment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS model_parallel,
 cond.n_prior AS cond_n_prior,
 cond.avg_rate AS cond_avg_serious_rate,
 cond.pooled_rate AS cond_pooled_serious_rate,
 cond.avg_aff AS cond_avg_serious_aff,
 cond.avg_lag AS cond_avg_lag_days,
 cond.avg_lag - extract(epoch from (s.seed_time - e.start_date))/86400.0 AS cond_lag_minus_elapsed,
 spon.n_prior AS spon_n_prior,
 spon.avg_rate AS spon_avg_serious_rate,
 spon.pooled_rate AS spon_pooled_serious_rate,
 spon.avg_lag AS spon_avg_lag_days,
 spon.avg_lag - extract(epoch from (s.seed_time - e.start_date))/86400.0 AS spon_lag_minus_elapsed,
 ph.avg_lag AS phase_avg_lag_days,
 intv.n_prior AS intv_n_prior,
 intv.avg_rate AS intv_avg_serious_rate,
 intv.pooled_rate AS intv_pooled_serious_rate
FROM {seeds} s
LEFT JOIN public.studies e ON e.nct_id = s.nct_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT cs.allocation, cs.masking, cs.primary_purpose, cs.intervention_model FROM public.designs cs WHERE cs.nct_id = s.nct_id AND cs.date <= s.seed_time LIMIT 1) d ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ee.minimum_age, ee.maximum_age, ee.gender, ee.healthy_volunteers, ee.adult, ee.child,
  CASE WHEN ee.minimum_age ~ 'Year' THEN (regexp_match(ee.minimum_age,'[0-9.]+'))[1]::float
       WHEN ee.minimum_age ~ 'Month' THEN (regexp_match(ee.minimum_age,'[0-9.]+'))[1]::float/12.0
       WHEN ee.minimum_age ~ 'Week' THEN (regexp_match(ee.minimum_age,'[0-9.]+'))[1]::float/52.0
       WHEN ee.minimum_age ~ 'Day' THEN (regexp_match(ee.minimum_age,'[0-9.]+'))[1]::float/365.0 END AS min_age_years,
  CASE WHEN ee.maximum_age ~ 'Year' THEN (regexp_match(ee.maximum_age,'[0-9.]+'))[1]::float
       WHEN ee.maximum_age ~ 'Month' THEN (regexp_match(ee.maximum_age,'[0-9.]+'))[1]::float/12.0
       WHEN ee.maximum_age ~ 'Week' THEN (regexp_match(ee.maximum_age,'[0-9.]+'))[1]::float/52.0
       WHEN ee.maximum_age ~ 'Day' THEN (regexp_match(ee.maximum_age,'[0-9.]+'))[1]::float/365.0 END AS max_age_years
  FROM public.eligibilities ee WHERE ee.nct_id = s.nct_id AND ee.date <= s.seed_time LIMIT 1) el ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) AS n_conditions FROM public.conditions_studies cs WHERE cs.nct_id = s.nct_id AND cs.date <= s.seed_time) c ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) AS n_interventions FROM public.interventions_studies ist WHERE ist.nct_id = s.nct_id AND ist.date <= s.seed_time) i ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) AS n_facilities, count(DISTINCT fc.country) AS n_countries, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fc.country='United States') AS n_us_facilities FROM public.facilities_studies fs JOIN public.facilities fc ON fc.facility_id = fs.facility_id WHERE fs.nct_id = s.nct_id AND fs.date <= s.seed_time) fa ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss.lead_or_collaborator='collaborator') AS n_collab, min(ss.sponsor_id) FILTER (WHERE ss.lead_or_collaborator='lead') AS lead_id FROM public.sponsors_studies ss WHERE ss.nct_id = s.nct_id AND ss.date <= s.seed_time) spx ON true
LEFT JOIN public.sponsors sp ON sp.sponsor_id = spx.lead_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) AS n_prior,
         avg(ae.serious_aff / nullif(ae.risk,0)) AS avg_rate,
         sum(ae.serious_aff)::float / nullif(sum(ae.risk),0) AS pooled_rate,
         avg(ae.serious_aff) AS avg_aff,
         avg(ae.lag_days) AS avg_lag
  FROM public.conditions_studies sc
  JOIN public.conditions_studies cs2 ON cs2.condition_id = sc.condition_id AND cs2.nct_id <> s.nct_id AND cs2.date <= s.seed_time
  JOIN ae ON ae.nct_id = cs2.nct_id AND ae.report_date <= s.seed_time AND ae.risk > 0
  WHERE sc.nct_id = s.nct_id AND sc.date <= s.seed_time
) cond ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) AS n_prior,
         avg(ae.serious_aff / nullif(ae.risk,0)) AS avg_rate,
         sum(ae.serious_aff)::float / nullif(sum(ae.risk),0) AS pooled_rate,
         avg(ae.lag_days) AS avg_lag
  FROM public.sponsors_studies ss2
  JOIN ae ON ae.nct_id = ss2.nct_id AND ae.report_date <= s.seed_time AND ae.risk > 0
  WHERE ss2.sponsor_id = spx.lead_id AND ss2.lead_or_collaborator='lead' AND ss2.nct_id <> s.nct_id AND ss2.date <= s.seed_time
) spon ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT avg(ae.lag_days) AS avg_lag, count(*) AS n
  FROM ae WHERE ae.phase = e.phase AND ae.report_date <= s.seed_time
) ph ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) AS n_prior,
         avg(ae.serious_aff / nullif(ae.risk,0)) AS avg_rate,
         sum(ae.serious_aff)::float / nullif(sum(ae.risk),0) AS pooled_rate
  FROM public.interventions_studies is1
  JOIN public.interventions_studies is2 ON is2.intervention_id = is1.intervention_id AND is2.nct_id <> s.nct_id AND is2.date <= s.seed_time
  JOIN ae ON ae.nct_id = is2.nct_id AND ae.report_date <= s.seed_time AND ae.risk > 0
  WHERE is1.nct_id = s.nct_id AND is1.date <= s.seed_time
) intv ON true
